description: Guest verification code: sending, throttling and unknown-invitation answers.

cases.log: Challenge row added; verification email sent to the invited address.
preconditions: Open invitation I1 for guest.a@example.com, name "Trần Khách", meeting "Họp giao ban".
No verification code was created for I1 in the last 24 hours.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success with GuestCodeSent { expiresInSeconds: 900, resendAfterSeconds: 60 } (MSG375); one challenge row saved with a 6-digit code stored only as a hash, expiring in 15 minutes; the code is sent to guest.a@example.com.
GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371); no code is created or sent.

preconditions: Invitation I1 is revoked, or its meeting is Ended.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(InvalidInvitation) (MSG371); no code is created or sent.

preconditions: The last code of I1 was created 20 seconds ago; resend interval is 60 seconds.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(TooSoon) with retryAfterSeconds 40 (MSG373); no new code, nothing sent.

cases.log: Challenge row added; verification email sent.
preconditions: The last code of I1 was created exactly 60 seconds ago.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success (MSG375): the wait has just elapsed, so a new code is created and sent.

preconditions: The last code of I1 was created 59 seconds ago.
20 codes were created for I1 in the last 24 hours (the oldest 23 hours ago); the newest was 2 minutes ago.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(DailyLimit) (MSG379) with retryAfterSeconds = 3600 (until the oldest counted code is 24 hours old); nothing sent.

cases.log: Challenge row added; verification email sent.
preconditions: 19 codes were created for I1 in the last 24 hours; the newest was 2 minutes ago.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success (MSG375): the 20th code of the day is still allowed.

preconditions: 20 codes in the last 24 hours and the newest was 10 seconds ago.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(TooSoon) (MSG373): the resend wait is checked before the daily cap.

preconditions: I1 has 3 challenge rows older than 24 hours and none newer.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult success (MSG375); the 3 expired challenge rows are deleted before the new one is added.

preconditions: Email transport reports the message was not delivered.
cases.return: GuestAccessResult Failure(Unavailable) (MSG374); the new challenge row is removed again so the guest may retry at once and the previous code stays usable.

preconditions: The client disconnects while the email is being sent.
cases.return: The cancellation propagates to the caller; the new challenge row is removed even after cancellation.

cases.log: Error log "Could not save a verification code for guest invitation {InvitationId}."
preconditions: Saving the challenge fails with a persistence error.

precondition: Guest invitation seeded; code sender replaced by a recorder.
